headline: Sula Vineyards submits postal ballot scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Postal ballot voting results now available
summary: Sula Vineyards Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer report and voting results from its recent postal ballot to the stock exchanges. Shareholders voted on resolutions presented through the postal ballot process. Such routine governance filings have minimal immediate impact on the company's financial performance or stock price. Indian retail shareholders can access the detailed voting outcomes on the NSE portal.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no direct impact on stock price.
